Capabilities that are installed and unused. Nothing is removed automatically and nothing is called rubbish — a server nobody has called might be worthless, or might be the one that matters twice a year.
Unused for 30 days
elements.helpText: Chooses how long a server must be quiet before the board proposes it for removal.

elements.name: Under the router an unused server costs a few kilobytes of cached schema and nothing else — no process, no memory, no start-up. The reason to remove one is that its tools are cluttering the model's list, or that you no longer trust it. Both are your call, and neither is disk space.
Only MCP servers are listed. The router serves no skills route on this build, so whether a skill is unused is something this board has no reading for and does not guess.
